notes.title: Game experience optimization of League of Fighters
notes.notes:
In response to players' feedback that the game is too difficult in the first stages, the game has made the following adjustments.

1. Greatly reduce the probability of encountering enemies on the map.

2. Reduce the enemy's health.

3. Enhance the protagonist's skills, and learn some skills in advance.

4. Adjust the camera, now the camera can be zoomed in and out for situations where global observation is required. (Mouse wheel zoom, middle button reset. Keyboard T, G, zoom, P, reset. Controller RB + LB/LR, zoom, R3 reset.)

5. Reduce the duration and damage of DEBUFFs such as poison and fire.

6. Reduce the duration of abnormal status on maps.

7. Weakened the strength of enemy skills "Dark Circles" and "Shock Device".

8. Increased the experience multiplier after the battle.

9. Increased the time for the fast countdown in the training cave.

Bug fixes
Fixed the plot bug in the town at the foot of the mountain.

notes.title: 武道传说（League of Fighters）
notes.notes:
Dear friends, hello!

The game "League of Fighters" has been reviewed and officially released today. Thank you for your continued attention and support.

Since the game engine used does not support dynamic language switching in the game, only "Simplified Chinese" is used for the time being. The engine developer said that an update will be released in 2024 to support the function of dynamic language switching in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44532961/d64654ef7ca4e83765fa4aaeda9f69db59af282b.jpg[/img]

When the engine version is updated to support dynamic language switching in the game, I will update the game to support more languages.

Best regards!

notes.title: Regarding the possible delay in the release of the game "League of Fighters"
notes.notes:
Dear friends, hello!

Since more materials are required for the review process, the review may take a long time. The release date of previously released games may be delayed. Since the release date cannot be modified within two weeks, I postponed the release date in advance to allow for the necessary time for the review.

I really hope that my game will participate in the Turn-Based Game Festival on October 1 this year. If the review goes smoothly and passes before October 1, I will release it as scheduled. If there is a delay, it will be released as soon as the review process is completed and notified.

I am very sorry for the trouble caused to you.

Best regards!

notes.title: "Legaue of Fighters"released
notes.notes:
Dear friends, hello!

I am very happy to announce that after unremitting efforts, the full version of "League of Fighters" will be officially released on October 1st! This is an exciting moment, and I can't wait to share this exciting adventure with you.

I sincerely thank you for your continued support and patience. If there are no unexpected circumstances, you will experience the new fun and challenges I bring to you on this long-awaited day.

Thank you again for your attention and support, and I look forward to embarking on this wonderful game journey with you on October 1st!

I wish you a happy game!

Best regards!
                                                                                                                                                   Lin Wenjian

notes.title: Temporarily remove the store
notes.notes:
League of Fighters 

The personal independent game I produced released the store page and demo in August 2023.

Because some images were used to create game materials using AI drawing tools, Steam did not make relevant regulations on this content at the time.

Although my image content did not contain illegal or infringing content, it still confused me, so I made a difficult decision to cancel all AI image content and choose other way to create artworks. Although this is a big blow to me, based on the principle of fairness, I should be responsible to all community players and to Steam. This is the determination I must have as a game developer.

So, I want to temporarily remove the store interface, because some pictures of the store interface are drawn by AI and may be different from the actual pictures of the final version of the game. This would be misleading to players viewing the store, and I don't want that.

After the version of my game is updated, I will apply for review and release.

I'm very sorry for causing you trouble.

Best regards!
